summary.ko: 인간-중심 AI 기술과 디자인의 미래를 주제로 한 발표 세미나를 개최합니다.
summary.en: A seminar on human-centered AI technology and the future of design.

ko: 인간-중심 AI 기술과 디자인의 미래를 주제로 한 발표 세미나를 개최합니다. North Carolina State University의 Prof. Byungsoo Kim과 Carnegie Mellon University의 Prof. Haeyoung Kim이 「Human-Centered Interactions with Emerging Technologies: From AI Co-Creation to Physical–Digital Experience」 발표를 시작으로, AI 시대의 디자인 워크플로우 재정의와 인간-중심 상호작용을 주제로 한 연구진들의 발표가 이어집니다. 기술과 인간의 창의적 협업이 만들어갈 새로운 디자인 경험을 함께 살펴보는 자리입니다.
- **13:00 – 15:00** · Prof. Byungsoo Kim (NCSU), Prof. Haeyoung Kim (CMU) — Human-Centered Interactions with Emerging Technologies: From AI Co-Creation to Physical–Digital Experience
- **15:00 – 15:10** · Prof. Kyung Hoon Hyun (HYU) — Designing with AI: Redefining Design Workflows
- **15:10 – 15:30** · Seung Won Lee (HYU) — Design Behavior Modeling for Guiding Design Process
- **15:30 – 15:50** · Semin Jin (HYU) — Human-Centered Evaluation for Generative Spatial Design
- **15:50 – 16:10** · Jiin Choi (HYU) — Supporting Cognitive Indeterminacy in Human-AI Design
- **Prof. Byungsoo Kim** — Assistant Professor, College of Design, North Carolina State University
- **Prof. Haeyoung Kim** — Assistant Professor, School of Design, Carnegie Mellon University
- 한양대학교 인간-중심 AI디자인 연구센터 · North Carolina State University · Carnegie Mellon University
en: A seminar on human-centered AI technology and the future of design. Opening with a talk by Prof. Byungsoo Kim (North Carolina State University) and Prof. Haeyoung Kim (Carnegie Mellon University) on “Human-Centered Interactions with Emerging Technologies: From AI Co-Creation to Physical–Digital Experience,” the program continues with presentations on redefining design workflows in the age of AI and on human-centered interaction.
- Room 504, College of Human Ecology, Hanyang University, 222 Wangsimni-ro, Seongdong-gu, Seoul
- **13:00 – 15:00** · Prof. Byungsoo Kim (NCSU), Prof. Haeyoung Kim (CMU) — Human-Centered Interactions with Emerging Technologies: From AI Co-Creation to Physical–Digital Experience
- **15:00 – 15:10** · Prof. Kyung Hoon Hyun (HYU) — Designing with AI: Redefining Design Workflows
- **15:10 – 15:30** · Seung Won Lee (HYU) — Design Behavior Modeling for Guiding Design Process
- **15:30 – 15:50** · Semin Jin (HYU) — Human-Centered Evaluation for Generative Spatial Design
- **15:50 – 16:10** · Jiin Choi (HYU) — Supporting Cognitive Indeterminacy in Human-AI Design
- **Prof. Byungsoo Kim** — Assistant Professor, College of Design, North Carolina State University
- **Prof. Haeyoung Kim** — Assistant Professor, School of Design, Carnegie Mellon University
- Human-Centered AI Design Institute, Hanyang University · North Carolina State University · Carnegie Mellon University

summary.ko: 한양대학교는 인공지능 기술이 인간의 창의적 의사결정에 긍정적으로 기여할 수 있도록 연구하는 인간-중심 AI디자인 연구센터를 새롭게 개소하였습니다.
summary.en: Hanyang University has launched the Human-Centered AI Design Institute, dedicated to research on how AI can positively contribute to human creative decision-making.

ko: 한양대학교는 인공지능 기술이 인간의 창의적 의사결정에 긍정적으로 기여할 수 있도록 연구하는 인간-중심 AI디자인 연구센터를 새롭게 개소하였습니다.
앞으로 본 센터는 기술과 인간의 조화를 추구하는 다양한 융합 연구와 실증을 추진할 예정입니다.
en: Hanyang University has newly established the Human-Centered AI Design Institute, which researches how artificial intelligence can positively contribute to human creative decision-making.
Going forward, the Institute will pursue interdisciplinary research and empirical studies that seek harmony between technology and people.
